name: Nose exercises (nose yoga)
lead: Nose exercises, sometimes called nose yoga, are routines of flaring the nostrils, wiggling or scrunching the nose, or pressing on the tip, promoted as a way to strengthen nasal muscles and change the shape of the nostrils or nasal tip. They belong to the wider category of facial exercise or face yoga.

paras: Routines described by proponents involve repeatedly flaring, lifting or compressing the nose using the small muscles around it. The depressor septi nasi, one of these muscles, pulls the nasal tip and nostril base downward and also moves the nasal tip when the upper lip moves.[1]

card.summary: Nostril flaring and nose scrunching routines claimed to reshape the nose; no studies have tested them.

quick.overview:
Nose exercises are muscle routines such as nostril flaring that proponents say can slim the nostrils or lift the tip.

No published studies were found on whether they change nose shape.
quick.mechanism: Proponents say exercising the small muscles around the nose changes its shape. The nose's main structure is bone and cartilage, which these muscles do not directly reshape.
quick.risks: No documented harms specific to the practice were found.
